pick.headline: TWA 847 hostages freed via Damascus
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of July 1, 1985, reported Beirut radio on Birri announcing the 'happy ending': 39 Americans freed on U.S. pledges via Syria's Asad, with Israel reportedly ready to release 'Atlit detainees.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 126, 1 July 1985
evidence.snippet: FBIS MIDDLE EAST & DAILY REPORT SOUTH ASIA REVIEW 1 JULY 1985 Hostages’ Release Announcing the “happy ending” of the hostages affair at a 30 June press conference reported by Beirut radio, Ama! movement leader Nabih Birri stressed that the decision to release the 39 Americans was in accord…
